snippet.title: Superspeed Deluxe gameplay (PC Game, 1995)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Superspeed Deluxe, Dos PC game produced by Tom Fresen in 1995 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/superspeed-deluxe/4989/
Superspeed Deluxe is a pretty nice game, race cars, very thrilling. It's playing in a top down perspective, with a pretty good graphics, worth trying.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
